At first I thought it looked durable and would protect my dryer against the elements, primarily rain. It seemed to be doing the job at first, however, after a heavy down pour water still seeped through from the water that settled on it and the top of the dryer got wet. In addition, it doesn’t go all the way down to the bottom of the dryer which leaves part exposed to get wet as well.
I do like the design hence the reason I gave it three stars. Was really hoping that this would be water proof however it only protects from small amounts of water.

These are well made, zippers and material are good quality. However I distinctly remember the page stating that these were fade resistant in the sun and that is just simply not the case. I purchased the Palm Frond Leaves print which is beautiful, but our W/D set are outdoors and get sun for about half of the day and the green colors faded to tan/brown within weeks. I also want to note that the sizing on this must be for a very tall and thick washer and dryer because we have some of the newer (past 5 years) units that are slightly bigger and these are still a bit baggy up by the control panel. Overall happy with purchase,  It still functions perfectly and protects our units from rain and dust, just wishing the sizing was better and the colors were actually fade resistant.
